question: Did FOUR beat or miss its end to end payment volume guidance at midpoint for Q3 2024 provided in Q1 2024? Express as % BEAT or MISS
model_answer:
**MISS — by ~7.4%** (actual came in $3.5B below the midpoint).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Q3 2024 E2E volume guidance (issued with Q1 2024 results, May 9, 2024) | $46.0B – $48.0B |
| Midpoint of guidance | $47.0B |
| Q3 2024 actual E2E payment volume | $43.5B |
| Variance vs. midpoint | –$3.5B |
| Variance % | **–7.4% → MISS** |

Details:
- Shift4 introduced quarter-by-quarter guidance in its Q1 2024 shareholder letter, laying out Q3 2024 end‑to‑end payment volume of **$46.0B–$48.0B** (midpoint **$47.0B**), alongside Q3 GRLNF of $345M–$365M and Adjusted EBITDA of $175M–$183M.
- Actual Q3 2024 E2E volume, reported Nov 12, 2024, was **$43.5B** (+56% YoY), i.e., **$3.5B / 7.4% short of the $47.0B midpoint** (~5.4% below the low end of the range).
- Consequently, the company cut its full‑year E2E volume outlook from $167B–$175B (later $167B–$172B) to $164B–$166B.

Computation: (43.5 − 47.0) / 47.0 = −7.45% → **MISS 7.4%**.
judge_reason: The answer states a 7.4% miss, matching the official answer.
